objectives.statement: Choose connectors that express cause, addition, contrast, and concession in natural Bokmål.
Apply main-clause V2 and subordinate-clause word order after key discourse connectors.
Build short, coherent Norwegian sentences that connect ideas without changing their meaning.

notes: B2 cohesion guardrail. Must show connectors across cause, contrast, addition, and concession, with correct main-clause V2 after derfor/likevel/derimot and subordinate word order after fordi/selv om.
